title: Model first: implement a feature the developer modelled
prompt: I've modelled discontinuing catalog items in the designers: CatalogItem.IsDiscontinued and a PUT /api/catalog/items/{id}/discontinue endpoint. Implement it, and hide discontinued items from the item lists.
done: the discontinue endpoint sets the item's IsDiscontinued and saves it, and the item list endpoints leave discontinued items out

expect.text: CatalogItem.IsDiscontinued and the discontinue endpoint's method are in the code, merged into the existing hand-written files with no hand-written code lost.
The developer's model changes are kept as they were modelled.
